verdict.rationale: Brave documents an LLM Context endpoint that returns pre-extracted page content with no scraping needed, and configurable token and URL limits. Web search also offers up to 5 extra snippets per result, so developers get more than short snippets. However, the content is token-budgeted and relevance-thresholded, so the evidence does not show retrieval of full page text or a markdown format. Missing for 10: explicit full-page text retrieval, markdown output format, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction depth.
